title: Continuous Voter Registration 2025–2026 — official phase statements

reconciliation.note: Two official INEC statements report different phase-one totals by two voters. The reviewed official source set does not contain a final consolidated nationwide post-CVR register after the timetable's 30 August 2026 claims/objections period.

methodology: Transcription of INEC official Chairman's remarks, press release and published CVR timetable. These are statements and timetable milestones, not a final validated nationwide register.
limitations: The two official phase-one statements differ by two registrations; retain both values until INEC clarifies the authoritative figure.
The timetable shows the scheduled phases and register display dates; it does not itself prove final completion or the final validated register.
No final consolidated nationwide post-CVR register total and state/LGA breakdown was located in the official sources reviewed on 4 November 2026.
New registrations are not the same as a validated register; transfers, corrections, duplicate removal and other adjustments may affect final totals.
Do not add the phase-one count to the 2023 national register to claim a current national total.
